title: Pensioner syndicate protest stands reported across 11 cities; one Tripoli assembly described in English
location: Multi-site lead: Arabic LANA report names stands in Misrata, Bani Walid, Zliten, Khoms, Tripoli, Zwara, Zawiya, Sabrata, Surman, Gharyan and Maslata; English LANA report describes an assembly outside GNA headquarters in Tripoli. Relationship between accounts is unresolved.
scope: Arabic LANA account reports same-morning protest stands in 11 cities; English account describes one Tripoli gathering attended by syndicate members from multiple cities. Treat attendance separately by physical site; no city pooling.
organizer: Pensioner syndicates; the Arabic LANA report attributes statements to city syndicates and quotes the national syndicate head; English LANA report says members came from multiple cities.
participants_original: Neither opened LANA report gives a crowd count for any physical site.
threshold_50_evidence: No crowd count per site in either LANA report. The reported 11 cities, multiple-city participant origins, 107 prior memoranda and LD 500 million arrears allocation are not attendance estimates; do not pool city crowds.

start_date.summary: Arabic LANA dates the protest stands to Feb 1, 2021; English LANA also dates its reported Tripoli assembly to Feb 1.

location.summary: Arabic LANA names protest stands in 11 cities. English LANA describes one gathering outside GNA headquarters in Tripoli by members from multiple cities. Spatial scope conflicts; do not collapse origins into physical sites or pool attendance.

organizer.summary: Both LANA reports attribute actions to pensioner syndicates; Arabic article quotes the national syndicate head.

demands.summary: Reports call for 2011 pension arrears under Presidential Council decision 377/2019, overdue health-insurance payments, the 2014 pension increase and spouse/child allowances. The Arabic article attributes prior nonresponse to the pensioner syndicate head; this is not a response to the Feb 1 gathering itself.

participants_original.summary: Neither article reports crowd size for any physical location.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No numeric attendance. The city list, multi-city participant origins, prior memoranda and arrears total cannot establish 50 at any single gathering.

notes: Uses one new Arabic LANA report and the already opened same-agency English report reused from the January dossier. They are not independent corroboration and differ on spatial scope: Arabic says stands in 11 cities; English says syndicate members from cities gathered in front of GNA HQ in Tripoli. Record as a linked same-day multi-site discovery lead with unresolved site-by-site boundaries and attendance; no crowd pooling. The February action is not assigned to January merely because syndicate members came from multiple cities.
open_questions: Does the Arabic account describe distinct physical stands at all 11 named sites, and how does the English Tripoli-only description relate to it?
Was attendance at least 50 at any individual site? Neither report provides a count.
Is there independent reporting that resolves site boundaries or supplies site-specific attendance?
What, if any, official response or physical end was documented for each reported stand?
